title: ArcGIS Earth
summary: Free 3D globe from Esri for viewing and sharing maps, KML, shapefiles and ArcGIS services.

title: ArcGIS Pro
summary: Esri's flagship 64-bit desktop GIS for mapping, editing, geoprocessing, 3D, imagery and spatial analysis, with Python scripting through ArcPy.
license: Proprietary (subscription or perpetual by license level)
caveat: Runs on Windows only. Extensions such as Spatial Analyst, 3D Analyst and Image Analyst are licensed separately.

title: ArcMap (ArcGIS Desktop)
summary: Esri's previous desktop GIS, replaced by ArcGIS Pro. Many older tutorials, models and scripts still target it.
caveat: ArcMap runs on 32-bit Python 2.7. Esri directs users to migrate to ArcGIS Pro. Check Esri's product life cycle page for the current support phase.

title: AutoCAD Map 3D toolset
summary: GIS and mapping toolset included with AutoCAD for working with spatial data inside CAD drawings.

title: Cadcorp SIS Desktop
summary: Windows desktop GIS built around OGC standards and spatial databases, from the UK vendor Cadcorp.

title: DIVA-GIS
summary: Free, lightweight desktop GIS for mapping and analyzing biodiversity and climate data, widely used in teaching.
caveat: The site lists version 7.5 from 2012. Prefer QGIS or R for new work.

title: Global Mapper
summary: Commercial desktop GIS known for broad format support and terrain, LiDAR and 3D analysis tools, with a Pro edition for point clouds and advanced analysis.

title: Google Earth Pro
summary: Free desktop globe for viewing imagery, importing KML and GIS files, measuring, and exporting high-resolution images and movies.

title: GRASS GIS
summary: Open source GIS for raster, vector, imagery and time-series analysis with hundreds of modules, usable from a GUI, the command line, Python or notebooks.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import grass.script as gs
gs.run_command("g.region", raster="elevation")
gs.run_command("r.slope.aspect", elevation="elevation", slope="slope")

title: gvSIG Desktop
summary: Open source desktop GIS written in Java, aimed at public administrations and education, with a plugin architecture.

title: Manifold
summary: Windows GIS and spatial SQL environment that runs queries and raster processing on multicore CPUs and GPUs. A free Viewer opens its project files.

title: MapInfo Pro
summary: Desktop GIS for location analysis and mapping, with scripting in MapBasic and Python.

title: Maptitude
summary: Business-oriented mapping software with built-in US demographic data, territory design and redistricting tools.

title: Marble
summary: KDE virtual globe and world atlas for desktop and mobile, with OpenStreetMap maps, routing and a Qt library for embedding.

title: OpenJUMP
summary: Java-based open source desktop GIS for viewing, editing and processing vector data, extensible with plugins and scripts.

title: OSGeo4W
summary: Windows installer and package repository for QGIS, GDAL, GRASS GIS and other open source geospatial tools and their dependencies.

title: OSGeoLive
summary: Bootable DVD, USB and virtual machine image preloaded with dozens of open source geospatial applications, sample data and quick starts.

title: QGIS
summary: Free, open source desktop GIS for viewing, editing, analyzing and publishing spatial data, extensible with Python plugins and the Processing framework.

snippets.label: PyQGIS
snippets.code:
from qgis.core import QgsVectorLayer, QgsProject
layer = QgsVectorLayer("roads.gpkg|layername=roads", "roads", "ogr")
QgsProject.instance().addMapLayer(layer)
print(layer.featureCount())

title: SAGA GIS
summary: Open source GIS with a large library of terrain, hydrology, geostatistics and image analysis tools, scriptable from Python and R.

title: TatukGIS
summary: Commercial desktop GIS plus developer kernels for building GIS applications on .NET, Delphi and other platforms.

title: TerrSet (IDRISI)
summary: Raster-oriented geospatial monitoring and modeling system that grew out of IDRISI, with Land Change Modeler and Earth Trends Modeler.

title: FlatGeobuf
summary: Binary vector format and libraries with a packed R-tree index, built for streaming and range-request reads from cloud storage.

title: GDAL
summary: The translator library for raster and vector geospatial formats, with the gdal and ogr2ogr command line tools and bindings for Python, Java, C# and others.

snippets.label: Command line
snippets.code:
gdalinfo dem.tif
ogr2ogr -f GPKG out.gpkg in.shp
gdalwarp -t_srs EPSG:4326 in.tif out.tif

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
from osgeo import gdal
ds = gdal.Open("dem.tif")
print(ds.RasterXSize, ds.RasterYSize, ds.GetProjection()[:40])

title: GeoArrow
summary: Specification and libraries for storing geometries in Apache Arrow arrays, enabling zero-copy exchange between tools. GeoParquet builds on the same encodings.

title: GeographicLib
summary: Library for geodesic calculations on the ellipsoid, map projections and grid references such as UTM, MGRS and geoid heights.

title: GEOS
summary: C++ port of the Java Topology Suite that implements the OGC Simple Features geometry predicates and operations used by PostGIS, Shapely and sf.

title: GeoTools
summary: Java library for reading and writing spatial formats, rendering maps and querying data, and the engine behind GeoServer.

title: H3
summary: Hierarchical hexagonal grid system for indexing locations, with bindings for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go and other languages.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import h3
cell = h3.latlng_to_cell(37.77, -122.42, 9)
print(cell, h3.cell_to_latlng(cell))

title: JTS Topology Suite
summary: Java library of 2D geometry types and spatial predicates, overlay and buffer operations, which GEOS ports to C++.

title: libgeotiff
summary: Library for reading and writing GeoTIFF georeferencing tags in TIFF files.

title: libspatialindex
summary: C++ library implementing R-tree, MVR-tree and TPR-tree spatial indexes. It underlies the Python Rtree package.

title: MDAL
summary: C++ library for reading and writing mesh and unstructured grid formats such as NetCDF, GRIB and HEC-RAS outputs. QGIS uses it for mesh layers.

title: osgEarth
summary: C++ SDK for building 3D map and globe applications on OpenSceneGraph, with terrain, imagery and feature rendering.

title: PDAL
summary: Library and command line tool for translating and processing point cloud data, described as GDAL for point clouds.

title: PROJ
summary: Coordinate transformation and projection library with the cs2cs and projinfo tools, and the EPSG database of coordinate reference systems.

title: S2 Geometry
summary: Library for spherical geometry that divides the globe into hierarchical cells, with a 64-bit cell ID scheme for indexing.

title: SFCGAL
summary: C++ wrapper around CGAL that adds 3D geometry operations such as extrusion, Minkowski sums and 3D intersection to PostGIS.

title: Shapelib
summary: C library for reading and writing ESRI Shapefiles and DBF files.

title: SpatiaLite
summary: Spatial extension for SQLite that adds geometry types, spatial functions and spatial indexes to a single-file database.

title: ArcGIS API for Python
summary: Esri's Python library for managing ArcGIS Online and Enterprise content, spatial analysis, and deep learning workflows.
caveat: The package is open source. Most functionality needs an ArcGIS Online or Enterprise account.

title: ArcPy
summary: Esri's Python site package for geoprocessing, map automation and data management inside ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Server.
caveat: Requires an ArcGIS Pro or ArcGIS Server license.

title: Cartopy
summary: Matplotlib-based mapping with projection support, transformations and Natural Earth feature layers for publication maps.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, cartopy.crs as ccrs
ax = plt.axes(projection=ccrs.Robinson())
ax.coastlines(); ax.gridlines()
plt.show()

title: contextily
summary: Adds web tile basemaps to GeoPandas and Matplotlib plots and downloads tiles for a bounding box.

title: dask-geopandas
summary: Parallel and out-of-core GeoPandas using Dask, with spatial partitioning for large vector datasets.

title: Datashader
summary: Rasterizes very large point, line and grid datasets into images so billions of records can be plotted without overplotting.

title: Earth Engine Python API
summary: Python client library for Google Earth Engine that runs analyses server side on its data catalog.
caveat: The client library is open source. Using Earth Engine requires a registered Google Cloud project, and commercial use needs a paid plan.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import ee
ee.Authenticate(); ee.Initialize(project="my-project")
img = ee.ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED").filterDate("2025-06-01", "2025-06-30").median()

title: earthaccess
summary: Python library to search, download and stream NASA Earthdata products with Earthdata Login authentication.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import earthaccess
earthaccess.login()
results = earthaccess.search_data(short_name="HLSL30", bounding_box=(-122.6, 37.6, -122.3, 37.9),
                                  temporal=("2025-06-01", "2025-06-30"))
files = earthaccess.download(results, "data/")

title: EODAG
summary: Python client and CLI that searches and downloads Earth observation products from many providers through one interface.

title: Fiona
summary: Python library for reading and writing vector formats through OGR, using GeoJSON-like dictionaries.
caveat: GeoPandas 1.0 defaults to pyogrio for file I/O. Fiona remains an optional engine.

title: folium
summary: Builds Leaflet maps from Python with choropleths, markers and plugins and exports them to standalone HTML.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import folium
m = folium.Map(location=[37.77, -122.42], zoom_start=11)
folium.Marker([37.77, -122.42], tooltip="SF").add_to(m)
m.save("map.html")

title: geemap
summary: Interactive mapping and analysis of Google Earth Engine data in Jupyter notebooks, with many other mapping backends.

title: GeoPandas
summary: Pandas extension that adds geometry columns, spatial joins, overlays and file reading and writing for vector data.

snippets.label: Install
snippets.code: pip install geopandas

snippets.label: Read and join
snippets.code:
import geopandas as gpd
counties = gpd.read_file("counties.gpkg")
pts = gpd.read_file("points.geojson").to_crs(counties.crs)
joined = gpd.sjoin(pts, counties, predicate="within")

title: GeoPy
summary: Python client for many geocoding services and geodesic distance calculations.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
from geopy.geocoders import Nominatim
loc = Nominatim(user_agent="my-app").geocode("Eiffel Tower")
print(loc.latitude, loc.longitude)

title: GeoViews
summary: HoloViz library that adds geographic plotting to HoloViews, with Bokeh and Matplotlib backends and Cartopy projections.

title: h3-py
summary: Official Python bindings for the H3 hexagonal grid library.

title: ipyleaflet
summary: Jupyter widget library that brings interactive Leaflet maps into notebooks with two-way Python and JavaScript communication.

title: laspy
summary: Pure Python library for reading, modifying and writing LAS and LAZ LiDAR files.

title: leafmap
summary: Python package for interactive geospatial mapping in Jupyter with ipyleaflet, folium, MapLibre and other backends.

title: lonboard
summary: Fast GeoPandas and GeoArrow visualization in Jupyter using deck.gl, able to render millions of features.

title: momepy
summary: Urban morphology measurement toolkit that quantifies buildings, streets and tessellations in GeoPandas.

title: MovingPandas
summary: Trajectory data analysis on GeoPandas, with tools for cleaning, splitting, generalizing and plotting movement tracks.

title: odc-stac
summary: Loads STAC items into xarray datasets with resampling and reprojection, from the Open Data Cube community.

title: OSMnx
summary: Downloads OpenStreetMap street networks and other features, models them as NetworkX graphs and computes routes and network metrics.
citation: Boeing, G. (2017). OSMnx. Computers, Environment and Urban Systems, 65, 126-139.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import osmnx as ox
G = ox.graph_from_place("Piedmont, California, USA", network_type="drive")
ox.plot_graph(G)

title: OWSLib
summary: Python client for OGC web services such as WMS, WFS, WCS and CSW, plus several OGC API clients.

title: Pandana
summary: Fast network analysis in Python for accessibility queries and shortest paths on street networks using contraction hierarchies.

title: planetary-computer (Python package)
summary: Python helper that signs asset URLs for Microsoft Planetary Computer data so STAC tools can read them.

title: pydeck
summary: Python bindings for deck.gl that render large geospatial layers in Jupyter and as HTML.

title: pygeoapi
summary: Python server implementing OGC API standards for features, coverages, tiles, processes and records.

title: PyGMT
summary: Python interface to the Generic Mapping Tools for publication-quality maps, grids and geophysical processing.

title: pyogrio
summary: Vectorized GDAL/OGR bindings for fast vector file I/O into NumPy and GeoPandas, and the default engine in GeoPandas 1.0.

title: pyproj
summary: Python interface to PROJ for coordinate reference system lookups, coordinate transformations and geodesic calculations.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
from pyproj import Transformer
t = Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:4326", "EPSG:32610", always_xy=True)
print(t.transform(-122.42, 37.77))

title: PySAL
summary: Family of Python packages for spatial analysis, including libpysal, esda, spreg, mgwr, spopt, segregation and tobler.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import geopandas as gpd
from libpysal import weights
from esda.moran import Moran
gdf = gpd.read_file("tracts.gpkg")
w = weights.Queen.from_dataframe(gdf); w.transform = "r"
print(Moran(gdf["income"], w).I)

title: PySTAC
summary: Python library for creating, reading and writing SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC) objects.

title: pystac-client
summary: Python client for searching STAC APIs, used with Microsoft Planetary Computer, Earth Search and other catalogs.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
from pystac_client import Client
cat = Client.open("https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1")
items = cat.search(collections=["sentinel-2-l2a"], bbox=[-122.6, 37.6, -122.3, 37.9],
                   datetime="2025-06-01/2025-06-30").item_collection()
print(len(items))

title: rasterio
summary: Pythonic raster I/O built on GDAL that reads and writes GeoTIFF and other formats as NumPy arrays, with warping, masking and windowed reads.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import rasterio
with rasterio.open("dem.tif") as src:
    band = src.read(1, masked=True)
    print(src.crs, src.res, band.mean())

title: rasterstats
summary: Summarizes raster values under vector geometries to compute zonal statistics, with a command line interface.

title: rio-cogeo
summary: Rasterio plugin and CLI to create and validate Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs.

snippets.label: Command line
snippets.code: rio cogeo create in.tif out_cog.tif

title: rio-tiler
summary: Reads map tiles, previews and statistics from COGs and other rasters using rasterio, the engine behind TiTiler.

title: rioxarray
summary: Adds rasterio-based CRS handling, reprojection, clipping and GeoTIFF I/O to xarray objects.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import rioxarray
da = rioxarray.open_rasterio("dem.tif", masked=True)
da.rio.reproject("EPSG:3857").rio.to_raster("dem_3857.tif")

title: Rtree
summary: Python wrapper for libspatialindex that provides R-tree spatial indexes for fast bounding-box and nearest-neighbor queries.

title: Shapely
summary: Python package for creating and manipulating planar geometries, built on GEOS with vectorized operations on NumPy arrays.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
from shapely.geometry import Point
buf = Point(0, 0).buffer(10)
print(buf.area, buf.contains(Point(3, 4)))

title: stackstac
summary: Turns a STAC item collection into a lazy, Dask-backed xarray DataArray.

title: TiTiler
summary: Dynamic raster tile server built on FastAPI and rio-tiler that serves tiles directly from COGs and STAC items.

title: whitebox (Python)
summary: Python frontend that runs WhiteboxTools geoprocessing tools from scripts and notebooks.

title: xarray
summary: Labeled multi-dimensional arrays for NetCDF, Zarr and GRIB data, the base of the Pangeo geoscience stack.

snippets.label: Python
snippets.code:
import xarray as xr
ds = xr.open_dataset("temp.nc")
print(ds["t2m"].mean("time"))

title: xarray-spatial
summary: Raster analytics on xarray and Numba, including slope, aspect, hillshade, zonal statistics and proximity, with Dask support.

title: xvec
summary: Vector data cubes for xarray that store geometries as a dimension coordinate and support zonal statistics and reprojection.

title: elevatr
summary: Retrieves point elevations and raster DEMs from AWS Terrain Tiles and other sources into R.

title: exactextractr
summary: Fast, accurate zonal statistics in R that weight raster cells by the fraction covered by each polygon.

title: gdalcubes
summary: Builds on-demand multidimensional data cubes from satellite image collections in R, with a C++ engine and Python bindings.

title: gdalraster
summary: R bindings to the GDAL API for low-level raster and vector access, with a GDALRaster class and utilities.

title: ggspatial
summary: Adds spatial data layers, scale bars, north arrows and basemap tiles to ggplot2 maps.

title: gstat
summary: Geostatistical modeling, variogram fitting, kriging and simulation in R.

title: landscapemetrics
summary: Calculates landscape metrics for categorical rasters in a tidy workflow, reproducing FRAGSTATS metrics.

title: leaflet (R)
summary: R interface to the Leaflet JavaScript library for interactive web maps in R Markdown and Shiny.

title: lidR
summary: Reads and processes airborne LiDAR data in R, with ground classification, canopy height models, tree segmentation and area-based metrics.

title: lwgeom
summary: R bindings to liblwgeom from PostGIS that add geodesic and other functions to sf.

title: mapgl
summary: R interface to Mapbox GL JS and MapLibre GL JS for interactive vector-tile maps in R and Shiny.

title: mapview
summary: Quick interactive viewing of spatial objects in R using Leaflet, with layer controls and synchronized views.

title: osmdata
summary: Downloads OpenStreetMap data through the Overpass API into sf or sp objects.

title: qgisprocess
summary: Runs QGIS Processing algorithms, including GRASS and SAGA providers, from R.

title: raster
summary: Original R package for raster data, still maintained but superseded by terra for most new work.
caveat: The author recommends terra for new projects.

title: rayshader
summary: Creates 2D and 3D hillshaded maps and visualizations from elevation matrices and ggplot2 objects in R.

title: rgee
summary: R client for Google Earth Engine that wraps the Python API through reticulate.

title: rgrass
summary: Interface between R and GRASS GIS, to run GRASS modules and exchange data with sf and terra.

title: rnaturalearth
summary: Loads Natural Earth boundaries, coastlines and populated places into R as sf or terra objects.

title: Rsagacmd
summary: R wrapper that exposes SAGA GIS tools as R functions and returns results as terra or sf objects.

title: rsi
summary: Retrieves satellite imagery from STAC catalogs and calculates spectral indices in R.

title: rstac
summary: R client for STAC APIs to search and access Earth observation assets.

title: s2 (R)
summary: R bindings to Google's S2 library, used by sf for spherical geometry on longitude and latitude coordinates.

title: sf
summary: Simple Features for R. Stores vector data as data frames with geometry columns and wraps GDAL, GEOS, PROJ and s2 for spatial operations.

snippets.label: R
snippets.code:
library(sf)
nc <- st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"))
nc_utm <- st_transform(nc, 32617)
st_area(nc_utm[1, ])

title: sits
summary: Satellite image time series analysis in R, from data cubes to machine learning classification and land use maps.

title: sp
summary: Classes and methods for spatial data in R that defined the ecosystem before sf. Kept for backward compatibility.
caveat: New code should use sf. The rgdal, rgeos and maptools packages that supported sp were retired from CRAN in 2023.

title: spatialreg
summary: Spatial lag, spatial error and related regression models for areal data in R, split out of spdep.

title: spatstat
summary: Analysis and modeling of spatial point patterns in R, including intensity, point process models and simulation.
provider: Adrian Baddeley, Rolf Turner and Ege Rubak

title: spdep
summary: Spatial weights, neighborhood graphs, Moran's I, Geary's C, local indicators and spatial regression diagnostics for R.

title: stars
summary: Spatiotemporal arrays for R that handle raster and vector data cubes, with lazy reading of large rasters and integration with sf.

title: terra
summary: R package for raster and vector data, the successor to raster, with fast C++ processing, large file support and a SpatRaster and SpatVector class system.

snippets.label: R
snippets.code:

r <- rast("dem.tif")

title: tidycensus

summary: Tidyverse methods and ggplot2 geoms for terra objects such as SpatRaster and SpatVector.

title: tigris
summary: Downloads and loads US Census TIGER/Line boundaries as sf objects.

title: tmap
summary: Thematic maps in R with a layered grammar similar to ggplot2, with static and interactive modes.

snippets.label: R

tm_shape(World) + tm_polygons("HPI")

title: whitebox (R)
summary: R frontend for WhiteboxTools, with hundreds of terrain, hydrology and LiDAR tools.

title: Apache SIS
summary: Java library for spatial information systems with ISO 19115 metadata, referencing by coordinates and feature and raster I/O.

title: ArchGDAL.jl
summary: High-level Julia interface to GDAL for reading and writing raster and vector data.

title: DotSpatial
summary: .NET library for spatial data, projections and map controls for Windows Forms applications.

summary: Rust bindings to GDAL for reading and writing raster and vector data.

title: geo (Rust)

summary: Esri's self-hosted GIS platform with ArcGIS Server, portal, data store and web apps for sharing maps and services inside an organization.

title: GeoServer
summary: Java server that publishes spatial data through OGC services such as WMS, WFS, WCS and WMTS, with a web admin interface and styling with SLD and CSS.

title: GeoWebCache
summary: Java tile cache that stores and serves WMS-backed map tiles through WMTS, TMS and other protocols. It is built into GeoServer.

title: Mapnik
summary: C++ toolkit for rendering vector and raster data into map tiles and images, used by OpenStreetMap's standard tile layer.

title: MapProxy
summary: Python proxy and tile cache that accelerates WMS and tile services, reprojects sources and merges layers.

title: MapServer
summary: C-based server and CGI engine for publishing maps and data through OGC services, configured with Mapfiles.

title: Martin
summary: Rust tile server that serves vector tiles from PostGIS, MBTiles and PMTiles, with sprite and font endpoints.

title: OpenMapTiles
summary: Vector tile schema and toolchain that turns OpenStreetMap data into a documented set of layers for basemaps.

title: pg_featureserv
summary: Go server that publishes PostGIS data as an OGC API Features service with JSON and GeoJSON output.

title: pg_tileserv
summary: Go server that publishes vector tiles from PostGIS tables, views and functions.

title: Planetiler
summary: Java tool that generates vector tiles for the whole planet from OpenStreetMap and other sources in hours on a single machine.

title: PMTiles
summary: Single-file archive format and tooling for tiles served with HTTP range requests from static storage, from Protomaps.

title: PyWPS
summary: Python implementation of the OGC Web Processing Service standard.

title: QGIS Server
summary: OGC web services backend that publishes QGIS projects as WMS, WFS, WCS and OGC API services using the same styling as the desktop.

title: STAC Browser
summary: Web interface for browsing and searching STAC catalogs and collections.

title: stac-fastapi
summary: Python implementation of the STAC API specification on FastAPI, with PostgreSQL and other backends.

title: Tegola
summary: Go vector tile server that reads PostGIS and GeoPackage and caches tiles to disk or cloud storage.

title: Terracotta
summary: Python tile server for serving raster files as XYZ tiles from a metadata database, designed to run serverless.

title: TileServer GL
summary: Node.js server for vector tiles and raster rendering from MBTiles and PMTiles using MapLibre GL styles.

title: tippecanoe
summary: Builds vector tilesets from large GeoJSON, FlatGeobuf and CSV collections, choosing which features to drop or simplify at each zoom level.

snippets.label: Command line
snippets.code: tippecanoe -zg -o out.pmtiles --drop-densest-as-needed in.geojson

title: ZOO-Project
summary: Open source implementation of OGC Web Processing Service and OGC API Processes for publishing geoprocessing as web services.

title: Apache Sedona
summary: Distributed spatial engine that adds geometry types, spatial SQL and raster operations to Apache Spark, Flink and Snowflake.

title: BigQuery GIS
summary: Geography type and spatial functions in Google BigQuery for large-scale analysis with SQL.

title: DuckDB spatial extension
summary: DuckDB extension that adds geometry types, spatial functions and GDAL-based file reading to an in-process analytical database.

snippets.label: SQL
snippets.code:
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
SELECT count(*) FROM ST_Read('counties.gpkg') WHERE ST_Area(geom) > 1;

title: GeoMesa
summary: Suite of tools for spatio-temporal indexing and querying on distributed stores such as Accumulo, HBase, Cassandra and Kafka.

title: H2GIS
summary: Spatial extension of the H2 Java database that implements OGC Simple Features SQL.

title: MobilityDB
summary: PostgreSQL and PostGIS extension for temporal and spatiotemporal types such as moving points and trajectories.

title: Oracle Spatial
summary: Spatial and graph features of Oracle Database for geometry storage, indexing, geocoding, routing and raster management.

title: pgRouting
summary: PostgreSQL and PostGIS extension with shortest path, driving distance and travelling salesperson algorithms.

title: PostGIS
summary: Spatial extension for PostgreSQL that adds geometry, geography and raster types, spatial indexes and hundreds of SQL functions.

snippets.label: SQL

title: rasdaman
summary: Array database for multi-dimensional rasters and datacubes with a query language and OGC WCS and WCPS support.

title: Snowflake geospatial
summary: GEOGRAPHY and GEOMETRY data types and spatial functions in the Snowflake data cloud.

title: SQL Server spatial types
summary: Built-in geometry and geography data types and spatial indexes in Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL Database.

title: Tile38
summary: In-memory geospatial database and geofencing server with real-time notifications over webhooks and pub/sub.

title: TileDB
summary: Array storage engine for dense and sparse multi-dimensional data such as rasters, point clouds and time series, with an open source core.

title: WherobotsDB
summary: Managed cloud platform from the creators of Apache Sedona for spatial analytics on vector and raster data.

title: AppEEARS
summary: NASA web tool and API for extracting and subsetting Earth observation samples by point or area, from the LP DAAC.
caveat: Requires a free NASA Earthdata Login.

title: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
summary: ESA-backed platform for searching, downloading and processing Copernicus Sentinel data through a browser, STAC, OData and openEO APIs.
caveat: The platform is free with registration. Processing quotas apply.

title: Digital Earth Africa
summary: Open platform and Python tools for analyzing Earth observation data over Africa, built on Open Data Cube with a sandbox, maps and training.

title: eCognition
summary: Commercial object-based image analysis software that segments and classifies imagery using rule sets and machine learning.

title: ENVI
summary: Commercial image analysis software for multispectral, hyperspectral, SAR and LiDAR data, with IDL scripting and a deep learning module.

title: eo-learn
summary: Python library of workflow tasks for building Earth observation pipelines from data download to machine learning.

title: ERDAS IMAGINE
summary: Hexagon's commercial remote sensing and photogrammetry suite for image processing, classification and mapping.

title: FORCE
summary: Framework for large-area processing of Landsat and Sentinel-2 archives into analysis-ready data, time series and higher-level products.

title: GeoWombat
summary: Python library for processing satellite imagery and time series with Rasterio and Xarray, including band math, mosaicking and sampling.

title: Google Earth Engine
summary: Cloud platform for planetary-scale analysis with a catalog of satellite imagery and geophysical datasets, a JavaScript Code Editor and Python and R clients.
caveat: Free for noncommercial research, education and nonprofit use. Commercial use requires a paid plan.

title: ISCE3
summary: JPL's InSAR scientific computing environment for processing synthetic aperture radar data into interferograms and displacement maps.

title: Microsoft Planetary Computer
summary: Catalog of open Earth observation datasets in Azure with a STAC API, a data Explorer and a Hub for Python analysis.
caveat: The STAC API and data catalog are free.

title: MintPy
summary: Python package for InSAR time series analysis that turns interferograms into surface displacement time series and velocity maps.

title: Open Data Cube
summary: Python framework for indexing, managing and analyzing large Earth observation archives as multi-dimensional data cubes.

title: openEO
summary: Open API and client libraries in Python, R and JavaScript for processing Earth observation data across different cloud back ends.

title: Orfeo ToolBox
summary: Open source library and applications for processing high-resolution optical, SAR and hyperspectral images, with Monteverdi and QGIS integration.

title: PCI Geomatica
summary: Commercial software for satellite and aerial image processing, orthorectification, SAR analysis and automated production workflows.
caveat: PCI Geomatics now markets the product line as CATALYST.

title: pyresample
summary: Python package for resampling geospatial image data between swath and area definitions, used by Satpy.

title: Satpy
summary: Python library for reading, resampling, compositing and writing data from weather and Earth observation satellites such as GOES, MSG and VIIRS.

title: Semi-Automatic Classification Plugin
summary: QGIS plugin for downloading, preprocessing and classifying satellite images and assessing accuracy.

title: Sen2Cor
summary: ESA processor that performs atmospheric, terrain and cirrus correction of Sentinel-2 Level-1C data to produce Level-2A surface reflectance.

title: Sentinel Hub
summary: Cloud API and EO Browser for streaming, processing and visualizing Sentinel, Landsat and commercial imagery with custom scripts.

title: sentinelhub-py
summary: Python package for the Sentinel Hub API that requests imagery, statistics and batch processing jobs.
caveat: The package is open source. The Sentinel Hub service behind it is metered.

title: SNAP (Sentinel Application Platform)
summary: ESA's open source toolbox for Sentinel and other Earth observation data, including the Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-3 toolboxes.

title: Spectral Python (SPy)
summary: Python module for processing hyperspectral image data, including classification, dimensionality reduction and ENVI file support.

title: 3DCityDB
summary: Open source database schema and tools to store, manage and export semantic 3D city models in CityGML and CityJSON on PostgreSQL.

title: Agisoft Metashape
summary: Commercial photogrammetry software for orthomosaics, DEMs, point clouds and textured 3D models from photos.

title: ArcGIS CityEngine
summary: Esri's rule-based 3D modeling application for generating cities and scenes from GIS data.

title: BlenderGIS
summary: Blender add-on that imports shapefiles, OpenStreetMap data, DEMs and web map tiles for 3D terrain and city models.

title: Cesium for Unreal
summary: Plugin that streams 3D Tiles terrain, imagery and photogrammetry into Unreal Engine on a WGS84 globe.

title: CGAL
summary: C++ library of computational geometry algorithms including triangulations, meshes, Voronoi diagrams and polygon operations.

title: cjio
summary: Python command line tool and library for manipulating, validating and converting CityJSON 3D city models.

title: CloudCompare
summary: Open source 3D point cloud and mesh viewer and editor with registration, comparison, segmentation and plugin support.

title: Entwine
summary: Data organization library for massive point cloud collections that builds streamable indexes, including Entwine Point Tiles.

title: FUSION/LDV
summary: USDA Forest Service software for viewing and analyzing LiDAR point clouds, with tools for canopy metrics and terrain models.

title: LAStools
summary: Fast command line tools for LiDAR processing, including LAZ compression, ground classification, gridding and tiling.
license: Mixed open source and proprietary (per tool)
caveat: Some tools are open source. Others are free for small files and need a license for commercial or large-scale use.

title: MicMac
summary: Open source photogrammetry suite from IGN for image orientation, dense matching and orthophoto production.

title: NASA Web WorldWind
summary: NASA's open source JavaScript virtual globe SDK for 3D maps in the browser.
license: NASA Open Source Agreement and Apache-2.0

title: OpenDroneMap
summary: Open source toolkit that turns drone and aerial photos into orthophotos, point clouds, DEMs and 3D models.

title: PIX4Dmapper
summary: Commercial photogrammetry software for drone mapping, producing orthomosaics, point clouds and elevation models.

title: Potree
summary: WebGL viewer for very large point clouds in the browser, with octree conversion tools.

title: WebODM
summary: Web interface for OpenDroneMap that manages drone mapping projects, processing tasks and results.
caveat: The software is open source. Native installers are sold for a one-time fee, and a hosted service is available.

title: Amazon Location Service
summary: AWS service for maps, places, geocoding, routing and device tracking using data from partners such as Esri, HERE and Grab.

title: ArcGIS Online
summary: Esri's hosted GIS for creating and sharing maps, apps, dashboards and layers, with analysis tools and the Living Atlas of content.

title: Azure Maps
summary: Microsoft Azure map rendering, search, routing, weather and spatial operations APIs with web and mobile SDKs.

title: CARTO
summary: Cloud-native location intelligence platform that runs spatial analysis in data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake and Databricks and builds web maps.

title: Felt
summary: Browser-based collaborative mapping tool for uploading data, styling layers, drawing and sharing maps.

title: Foursquare Studio
summary: Hosted map studio built on kepler.gl and deck.gl for visualizing and sharing large geospatial datasets.

title: Mapbox
summary: Hosted maps, tilesets, geocoding, directions and navigation APIs with Mapbox Studio for styling.

title: Mapillary
summary: Platform for street-level imagery collected by contributors, with APIs and an SDK, and map features derived from the photos.

title: MapTiler Cloud
summary: Hosted vector and raster maps, geocoding, elevation and tile hosting with a MapLibre-compatible API.

title: NASA Worldview
summary: Interactive web viewer for NASA satellite imagery layers with time animation, comparison and data download links.

title: Planet Platform
summary: Commercial satellite imagery and analytics platform with daily PlanetScope and SkySat imagery, APIs and a Python client.

title: Stadia Maps
summary: Hosted map tiles, geocoding and routing APIs built on open source engines such as Valhalla and Pelias.

title: UP42
summary: Marketplace and developer platform for geospatial data and processing workflows, including satellite imagery and analytics.

title: ArcGIS Network Analyst
summary: Esri extension for ArcGIS Pro that solves routing, service area, closest facility, OD cost matrix and vehicle routing problems.

title: GraphHopper
summary: Java routing engine and route optimization API with open source core, based on OpenStreetMap, with a hosted Directions API.

title: libpostal
summary: C library that parses and normalizes street addresses using statistical models trained on OpenStreetMap and OpenAddresses.

title: NetworkX
summary: Python package for creating and analyzing graphs, widely used for road and infrastructure network analysis with OSMnx.

title: Nominatim
summary: Geocoder for OpenStreetMap data that supports search by name and address and reverse geocoding. It powers the search box on openstreetmap.org.
caveat: The public instance has a strict usage policy. Run your own server for bulk work.

title: openrouteservice
summary: Routing, isochrone, matrix and geocoding services from Heidelberg University, available as open source software and a hosted API.

title: OpenTripPlanner
summary: Multimodal trip planner that combines GTFS transit, OpenStreetMap walking and cycling, and GBFS bike share data.

title: OSRM (Open Source Routing Machine)
summary: Fast C++ routing engine for road networks built on OpenStreetMap, with route, table, match and trip services.

title: Pelias
summary: Modular open source geocoder that imports OpenStreetMap, OpenAddresses, Who's On First and other sources into Elasticsearch.

title: Photon
summary: Search-as-you-type geocoder for OpenStreetMap data built on OpenSearch, with typo tolerance and multilingual results.

title: R5 (Conveyal)
summary: Java routing engine for fast multimodal transport accessibility analysis, with r5r and r5py wrappers.

title: sfnetworks
summary: R package that combines sf and tidygraph for spatial network analysis.

title: Valhalla
summary: Open source routing engine with tiled data, multimodal routing, isochrones, map matching and time-distance matrices.

title: FlamMap

provider: USDA Forest Service Missoula Fire Sciences Laboratory
caveat: Windows only. Needs a landscape file, for example from LANDFIRE. See the Awesome Fire Datasets catalog for input data.

title: gdaldem

snippets.label: Command line

gdaldem hillshade dem.tif hillshade.tif -z 2 -compute_edges
gdaldem slope dem.tif slope.tif -compute_edges

title: HEC-HMS
summary: US Army Corps of Engineers hydrologic modeling system for simulating rainfall-runoff and watershed processes, with GIS preprocessing.

title: HEC-RAS
summary: US Army Corps of Engineers software for one- and two-dimensional river hydraulics, with RAS Mapper for flood inundation mapping.

title: LISFLOOD-FP
summary: Raster-based two-dimensional flood inundation model from the University of Bristol for river and coastal flooding.
caveat: The current release is distributed through the University of Bristol and Zenodo. Check the site for the license of the version you use.

title: PCRaster
summary: Environmental modeling framework with a Python interface for building spatio-temporal dynamic models on rasters.

title: pysheds
summary: Python library for watershed delineation, flow routing and stream extraction from digital elevation models.

title: RichDEM
summary: High-performance terrain and hydrology library for depression filling, flow accumulation and slope calculations on very large DEMs.

title: SWAT+
summary: Watershed model for simulating water, sediment and nutrient yields under land management, with a QGIS interface called QSWAT+.
provider: Texas A&M AgriLife Research and USDA ARS

title: TauDEM
summary: Terrain Analysis Using Digital Elevation Models, with parallel tools for flow direction, watershed delineation and stream networks.

title: Verde
summary: Python library for processing and gridding spatial data such as bathymetry and gravity, with scikit-learn-style gridders.

title: WhiteboxTools
summary: Command line geoprocessing library with hundreds of terrain, hydrology, LiDAR and remote sensing tools, written in Rust.

title: WindNinja
summary: Computer program that computes spatially varying wind fields over complex terrain for fire behavior and other applications.
provider: USDA Forest Service Missoula Fire Sciences Laboratory
caveat: The Forest Service page lists terms for the software. Check them before redistributing.

title: Dinamica EGO
summary: Environmental modeling platform for land use and land cover change, with a graphical model builder and cellular automata.

title: dismo
summary: R package for species distribution modeling, including a Maxent interface, bioclimatic models and species data access.

title: FRAGSTATS
summary: Spatial pattern analysis program that computes landscape metrics for categorical maps.
provider: Kevin McGarigal, University of Massachusetts Amherst

title: GeoDa
summary: Free desktop software for exploratory spatial data analysis, with spatial autocorrelation, cluster maps and spatial regression.

title: GSTools
summary: Python toolbox for geostatistics with covariance models, random field generation, variogram estimation and kriging.

title: GWmodel
summary: R package for geographically weighted models, including regression, summary statistics, principal components and discriminant analysis.

title: InVEST
summary: Natural Capital Project suite of models for mapping and valuing ecosystem services such as carbon storage, water yield and habitat quality.

title: Marxan
summary: Decision support software for systematic conservation planning that selects efficient sets of areas to meet biodiversity targets.
provider: Marxan Solutions and University of Queensland

title: Maxent
summary: Java program that models species geographic distributions from presence-only records and environmental layers using maximum entropy.
provider: Steven Phillips, Miroslav Dudik and Robert Schapire

title: MGWR
summary: Multiscale geographically weighted regression in Python, with a desktop GUI and PySAL integration.
provider: Spatial Analysis Research Center, Arizona State University

title: prioritizr
summary: R package for systematic conservation prioritization using integer linear programming and flexible problem formulation.

title: PyKrige
summary: Kriging toolkit for Python with ordinary, universal and regression kriging and variogram models.

title: SaTScan
summary: Free software for spatial, temporal and space-time scan statistics used to detect disease clusters and other hotspots.
provider: Martin Kulldorff and Information Management Services

title: Zonation
summary: Spatial conservation prioritization software that ranks landscape cells by their value for biodiversity features.

title: ArcGIS Pro deep learning tools

title: blockCV
summary: R package for spatial and environmental blocking of training and test data to avoid optimistic accuracy estimates from spatial autocorrelation.

title: CAST
summary: R package for spatial and spatio-temporal machine learning, with forward feature selection and area of applicability estimation.

title: DeepForest
summary: Python package for detecting individual tree crowns in aerial RGB imagery with pretrained deep learning models.

title: geoai
summary: Python package for running AI workflows on geospatial data, including segmentation, object detection and model training.

title: mlr3spatial
summary: Extension for mlr3 that predicts machine learning models on raster and vector data in R.

title: Raster Vision
summary: Open source framework for deep learning on satellite and aerial imagery, covering chip classification, object detection and semantic segmentation.

title: segment-geospatial (samgeo)
summary: Python package that applies the Segment Anything Model to georeferenced imagery and exports masks as GeoTIFF or vector data.

title: TerraTorch
summary: Fine-tuning and benchmarking toolkit for geospatial foundation models such as Prithvi, built on PyTorch Lightning and TorchGeo.

title: TorchGeo
summary: PyTorch domain library with datasets, samplers, transforms and pretrained models for geospatial imagery.

title: ArcGIS Field Maps
summary: Esri's mobile app for field mapping, data collection, navigation and location tracking connected to ArcGIS.

title: ArcGIS Survey123
summary: Form-centric survey tool from Esri based on XLSForm, for collecting and analyzing location-aware surveys on web and mobile.

title: Avenza Maps
summary: Offline map viewer for Android and iOS that opens georeferenced PDFs and GeoTIFFs and records GPS tracks.

title: CoMapeo
summary: Offline, peer-to-peer mapping app for community mapping and monitoring, from Digital Democracy.

title: Epicollect5
summary: Free mobile and web data collection platform from Imperial College London for building forms with GPS fields and viewing maps.

title: Geopaparazzi
summary: Android app for digital field mapping with notes, photos, GPS logs and offline basemaps, with a desktop companion in gvSIG and QGIS.

title: KoboToolbox
summary: Free platform for field data collection built on ODK-compatible forms, widely used by humanitarian organizations.

title: Mergin Maps
summary: Field data collection app and sync service built on QGIS, with a mobile app, QGIS plugin and cloud sync.
caveat: The apps and server are open source. The hosted service has free and paid tiers.

title: ODK (Open Data Kit)
summary: Open source tools for building forms, collecting data on Android devices and managing submissions, with GPS and map questions.

title: Organic Maps
summary: Offline OpenStreetMap maps and navigation app for Android and iOS with no ads or tracking.

title: OsmAnd
summary: Offline OpenStreetMap navigation and map app for Android and iOS with vector maps, routing and GPX recording.

title: QField
summary: Mobile field GIS for Android, iOS and Windows that opens QGIS projects offline, for data collection, editing and navigation.

title: SW Maps
summary: Free Android and iOS app for GIS data collection and navigation with external GNSS receivers over Bluetooth.

title: iD
summary: Browser-based OpenStreetMap editor and the default editor on openstreetmap.org.

title: JOSM
summary: Java OpenStreetMap editor for advanced mapping, with plugins, imagery layers, validation and offline editing.

title: OpenStreetMap Carto
summary: CartoCSS stylesheet and Mapnik toolchain behind the standard map layer on openstreetmap.org.

title: osm2pgsql
summary: Imports OpenStreetMap data into a PostGIS database, with flexible Lua-based styling of tables and support for minutely updates.

summary: Command line tool for filtering, extracting, merging and converting OpenStreetMap data files, built on libosmium.

snippets.code:
osmium extract -b -122.6,37.6,-122.3,37.9 planet.osm.pbf -o sf.osm.pbf
osmium tags-filter sf.osm.pbf w/highway -o roads.osm.pbf

title: Osmosis
summary: Java command line tool for processing OpenStreetMap data, including filtering, merging and applying change files.

title: Overpass API
summary: Read-only API for querying OpenStreetMap data with a custom query language, with public instances and an Overpass Turbo web interface.

title: Overpass Turbo
summary: Web-based data mining tool that runs Overpass queries and shows results on a map, with export to GeoJSON, GPX and KML.

title: QuackOSM
summary: Python tool that reads OpenStreetMap PBF files with DuckDB and writes GeoParquet, without a database server.

title: StreetComplete
summary: Android app that improves OpenStreetMap by asking simple survey questions about places near you.

title: Datawrapper
summary: Web tool for building choropleth, symbol and locator maps and charts from tables, with embeds and exports for publishing.

title: ggplot2 with geom_sf
summary: ggplot2's geom_sf and coord_sf layers draw sf objects in R using the grammar of graphics, with automatic projection handling.

snippets.label: R
snippets.code:
library(ggplot2); library(sf)
nc <- st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"))
ggplot(nc) + geom_sf(aes(fill = AREA)) + coord_sf(crs = 5070)

title: GMT (Generic Mapping Tools)
summary: Command line toolset for processing geographic and Cartesian data and producing publication-quality maps and illustrations.

title: Mapshaper
summary: Editor and command line tool for simplifying, clipping, dissolving and converting polygon, line and point data, with a browser interface.

snippets.label: Command line
snippets.code: mapshaper counties.shp -simplify 10% -o counties_simple.geojson format=geojson

title: Maputnik
summary: Visual editor for MapLibre and Mapbox style specifications that runs in the browser or locally.

title: Observable Plot (geo marks)
summary: JavaScript charting library with geographic marks, projections and a graticule, for quick thematic maps in notebooks and web pages.

title: OpenOrienteering Mapper
summary: Software for drawing orienteering maps with symbol sets, templates and GPS and export tools.

title: QGIS Print Layout and Atlas
summary: QGIS map composer for building print-ready maps with scale bars, legends, grids and data-driven atlases that generate map series.

title: Tangram
summary: WebGL map renderer with a scene file format and shaders for custom 2D and 3D vector tile styling, with a native version for mobile.

title: ArcGIS Data Interoperability
summary: Esri extension, powered by FME technology, for reading, transforming and writing spatial data in many formats within ArcGIS Pro.

title: CKAN
summary: Open source data portal platform with spatial extensions for searching and previewing geospatial datasets.

title: FME
summary: Commercial spatial ETL platform with a visual workflow builder that converts and transforms hundreds of formats and automates data pipelines.

title: GeoNetwork opensource
summary: Catalog application for managing spatial metadata, with ISO 19115 editing, harvesting, CSW and OGC API Records interfaces.

title: GeoNode
summary: Geospatial content management system and spatial data infrastructure platform for publishing, sharing and styling data and maps.

title: gpq
summary: Command line utility that converts between GeoParquet and GeoJSON and validates GeoParquet files.

title: HALE Studio
summary: Open source tool for defining schema mappings and transforming geospatial data to INSPIRE and other target models.

summary: GDAL command line program that converts vector data between formats, reprojects, filters with SQL and loads data into databases.

snippets.label: Command line
snippets.code:
ogr2ogr -f GPKG parcels.gpkg parcels.shp -t_srs EPSG:4326
ogr2ogr -f PostgreSQL PG:"dbname=gis" parcels.gpkg -nln parcels
ogr2ogr -f Parquet parcels.parquet parcels.gpkg

title: pycsw
summary: Python server for publishing metadata and catalogs through OGC CSW, OGC API Records, OpenSearch and STAC.

title: pygeometa
summary: Python library for generating geospatial metadata in ISO 19139, OGC API Records and STAC from a simple configuration file.

title: CDO (Climate Data Operators)

title: cfgrib
summary: Python interface that maps GRIB files to the NetCDF data model and opens them with xarray using ecCodes.

title: Copernicus Marine Toolbox
summary: Python library and CLI for subsetting and downloading data from the Copernicus Marine Service.

title: Herbie
summary: Python package that downloads numerical weather prediction model output such as HRRR, GFS and ECMWF open data from cloud archives.

title: MetPy
summary: Python toolkit for reading, visualizing and calculating with meteorological data, including skew-T plots and units support.

title: ncview
summary: Quick-look viewer for NetCDF files with maps, animations and slicing through variables.

title: Panoply
summary: NASA GISS viewer for plotting geo-gridded arrays from NetCDF, HDF and GRIB files as maps, plots and animations.

title: PyFerret

title: wrf-python
summary: Python library of diagnostics and plotting routines for WRF-ARW model output.
